empty.title: No service calls yet
empty.body: A service call is the same financial row as a project or job, with a dispatch workspace — not a second money system.

pricing.priceHint: Service-call price. Commercial math uses the net amount (excluding VAT).
pricing.taxModeHint: Whether the price includes VAT. The rate comes from organization tax settings.

create.title: New service call
create.description: Field visit intake — customer, site, and schedule. Costs and billing stay on the same work record as projects and jobs.
create.namePlaceholder: e.g. AC not cooling — living room
create.assigneeHint: Who is going — can change later from Dispatch.
create.checklistHint: If you pick a form template, the technician must submit it before this call can be marked completed.
create.checklistUnavailable: Saved template (no longer in the list)

usualKind.workOrderTitle: Your organization usually creates service calls
usualKind.stayHint: This form is still available if you need a service call.
usualKind.sameEngine: Projects, jobs, and service calls are the same financial row with different screens.

workspace.sameEngineHint: Costs and billing use the same financial engine as projects and jobs — no duplicate Actual.

checklist.title: Required checklist
checklist.requiredBody: Submit this form before marking the service call completed.

errors.checklistRequired: Submit the required checklist before completing this service call.

billing.title: Bill this work
billing.hint: Creates a draft invoice with the existing billing engine. VAT is applied there. Billing is on this work order as a project; a primary contract is attached when one exists. You cannot bill the same work order twice while a live invoice exists.
billing.alreadyBilled: This work order already has a {status} invoice.
billing.negativeAmount: Amounts must be zero or more
billing.zeroAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero
billing.notWorkOrder: Only work orders can be billed here
billing.alreadyBilledError: This work order already has a live billing record

dispatch.title: Dispatch
dispatch.description: Assign and reschedule today’s work orders. This is the daily board — not the resource calendar and not project Gantt planning.
dispatch.overlapWarning: This assignee already has an overlapping booking. Confirm to keep both, or pick a different time.

empty.title: Nothing scheduled in this window
empty.body: Schedule a work order with a start time to see it here.

recurring.title: Recurring work
recurring.description: Service contracts and scheduled templates. Generated work orders stay draft until work is done — never silent revenue.

empty.title: No recurring templates yet
empty.body: Create a customer/site schedule. ProjectFlow will open draft work orders on each occurrence — you confirm work before money moves.

create.title: New recurring template
create.description: Optional service contract template. Pricing here is a hint only — generating never finalizes financials.

detail.title: Recurring template
detail.noHistory: No occurrences yet. Generate upcoming dates to open draft work orders.
detail.financialNote: Generated work orders are draft/scheduled only. Actual cost and revenue still require normal work completion and billing.

actions.generateHint: Opens draft/scheduled work orders through the next 30 days. Does not create Actual or invoices.

errors.recurrenceNotActive: Only active templates can generate work orders.
errors.occurrenceAlreadyGenerated: This occurrence already opened a work order.
